say: Riba hannun jari shine rabon farashin siyarwa wanda shine riba.
Don samun rata na kashi 40, raba farashin da 0.60. Hakan ya bada kimanin naira 4,765.
Halima ta tara tsaf har naira 4,800.
Ribar da ta samu ya kai Naira 1,941 akan kowacce kyandir.
Wani kantin kyauta yana neman kashi 25 cikin dari.
Farashin ya sauka zuwa naira 3,600, kuma ribar ta zuwa 741 kacal.
Wannan zai iya zama darajarsa don babban tsari na yau da kullum, amma ba don kyandir uku ba.
Don haka saita mafi ƙarancin oda don siyarwa.

say: Kafin ka saki kaya, duba cewa kuɗin yana cikin asusunka, a bankin ku, Opay ko Moniepoint app.
Faɗakarwar karya yaudara ce ta gama gari, don haka kar a amince da hoton allo ko SMS ɗin da mai siye ya aiko.
Ɗauki ajiya don umarni na al'ada, kuma kiyaye rikodin tallace-tallace mai sauƙi.

say: Don tunawa.
Ka riƙe alamarka gaskiya da gwadawa.
Cika kuɗin duka, gami da marufi, gas, aikin ku da kyandir ɗin gwajin ku.
Raba da 1 ban da gefen ku, sannan zagaye.
Kuma saki kaya kawai bayan kuɗin yana cikin asusun ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Lakabi ma'aunin nauyi, kakin zuma na gaskiya, lokacin ƙonawa da aka gwada
Yi amfani da ƙananan lokacin ƙonawa, zagaye ƙasa
Cika cikakken tsari, gami da aikin ku
Farashin = farashin da aka raba ta (raɓar ragi 1)
Saki kaya kawai idan kun ga kuɗin

say: Yanzu tsara lakabin ku kuma gwada lokacin kuna.
Sannan ku kashe bashi ɗaya daga rasidin ku na gaske, ku fitar da farashin dillali da na jimla, sannan ku sanya jerin farashin ku a cikin kundin kasuwancin ku na WhatsApp.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Zana alamar ku kuma gudanar da gwajin lokacin ƙonawa
Shirya kyandir mai lakabi ɗaya a matsayin kyauta
Farashin bashi ɗaya daga rasidu na gaske
Sanya lissafin farashin ku akan Kasuwancin WhatsApp
